cd /workspace && cat > tmp/pr.py <<'PY'
def push_relabel_cutoff(nH,hadj,others,x,y,limit):
    if x==y:return limit
    nbase=nH+len(others)
    S=nbase
    n=nbase+1
    adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
    to=[];cap=[]
    for u,d in enumerate(hadj):
        au=adj[u]
        for v,c in d.items():
            if c>0:
                if c>limit:c=limit
                e=len(to);au.append(e);to.append(v);cap.append(c)
                adj[v].append(e+1);to.append(u);cap.append(0)
    sbase=nH
    for i,(C,V) in enumerate(others):
        s=sbase+i
        e=len(to);c=C if C<limit else limit
        adj[x].append(e);to.append(s);cap.append(c)
        adj[s].append(e+1);to.append(x);cap.append(0)
        as_=adj[s]
        for v in V:
            e=len(to);as_.append(e);to.append(v);cap.append(limit)
            adj[v].append(e+1);to.append(s);cap.append(0)
    # super source -> x
    e=len(to);adj[S].append(e);to.append(x);cap.append(limit)
    adj[x].append(e+1);to.append(S);cap.append(0)
    # preflow from S
    he=[0]*n; ex=[0]*n; cur=[0]*n
    he[S]=n
    for e in adj[S]:
        f=cap[e]
        if f:
            cap[e]=0;cap[e^1]+=f
            v=to[e];ex[v]+=f;ex[S]-=f
    INFH=2*n+3
    buckets=[[] for _ in range(INFH+1)]
    active=[False]*n
    maxh=0
    if ex[x]>0:
        active[x]=True;buckets[he[x]].append(x)
    def enqueue(v):
        nonlocal maxh
        if v!=S and v!=y and ex[v]>0 and not active[v]:
            active[v]=True;hv=he[v]
            buckets[hv].append(v)
            if hv>maxh:maxh=hv
    while maxh>=0:
        while maxh>=0 and not buckets[maxh]:maxh-=1
        if maxh<0:break
        u=buckets[maxh].pop();active[u]=False
        au=adj[u]
        while ex[u]>0:
            i=cur[u]
            if i<len(au):
                e=au[i];v=to[e]
                if cap[e]>0 and he[u]==he[v]+1:
                    f=ex[u]
                    if cap[e]<f:f=cap[e]
                    cap[e]-=f;cap[e^1]+=f;ex[u]-=f;ex[v]+=f
                    if v!=S and v!=y and ex[v]>0 and not active[v]:
                        active[v]=True;hev=he[v];buckets[hev].append(v)
                        if hev>maxh:maxh=hev
                else:
                    cur[u]=i+1
            else:
                mh=INFH
                for e in au:
                    if cap[e]>0:
                        hv=he[to[e]]
                        if hv<mh:mh=hv
                nh=mh+1 if mh<INFH else INFH
                he[u]=nh;cur[u]=0
                break
        if ex[u]>0 and not active[u]:
            hv=he[u]
            active[u]=True;buckets[hv].append(u)
            if hv>maxh:maxh=hv
    return ex[y]
